question: What is the name and citation point of the unversities with the top 3 reputation points?

SELECT university_id, University_Name FROM unpvt
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "university_metrics" AS SELECT "rank" AS "rank", "uni_id" AS "uni_id", "reputation_point" AS "reputation_point", "cit_p" AS "cit_p" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH name_map AS (
    SELECT 1 AS university_id, "1" AS University_Name FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 2, "2" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 3, "3" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 4, "4" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 5, "5" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 6, "6" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 7, "7" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 8, "8" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 9, "9" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 10, "10" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 11, "11" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 12, "12" FROM universities
    UNION ALL SELECT 13, "13" FROM universities
)
SELECT nm.University_Name AS university_name,
       m.cit_p AS citation_point,
       m.reputation_point
FROM university_metrics m
JOIN name_map nm ON nm.university_id = m.uni_id
ORDER BY m.reputation_point DESC, m.cit_p DESC
LIMIT 3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT u.University_Name AS university_name,
       m.cit_p AS citation_point,
       m.reputation_point
FROM university_metrics m
JOIN universities u
  ON u.university_id = m.uni_id
ORDER BY m.reputation_point DESC, m.cit_p DESC, u.University_Name ASC
LIMIT 3;

# Create final small result: top 3 by reputation with names and citation points
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT u.University_Name AS university_name,
       m.cit_p AS citation_point,
       m.reputation_point
FROM university_metrics m
JOIN universities u
  ON u.university_id = m.uni_id
ORDER BY m.reputation_point DESC, m.cit_p DESC, u.University_Name ASC
LIMIT 3;
'''
